candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `credit[msg.sender]=0;` so credit is not cleared after withdrawal, allowing a second withdrawAll call to withdraw again.
Delete `require(callResult);` so a failed external call no longer reverts and the function continues, setting credit to 0 even on failure.
Delete `__lock_modifier0_lock = true;` in the modifier, removing the reentrancy guard so a reentrant call to withdrawAll can execute.
Delete `__lock_modifier0_lock = false;` after the `_` so the lock stays set forever, making any second withdrawAll call revert.
Delete the statement `credit[msg.sender]=0;` so the caller's credit is never cleared after withdrawal.
Move `credit[msg.sender]=0;` to before the external call (checks-effects-interactions), changing state visible during reentrancy.
Delete the `require(callResult);` check so state updates proceed even when the external call fails.
Remove the `__lock_modifier0` modifier invocation, disabling the reentrancy lock on withdrawAll.
Delete `__lock_modifier0_lock = true;` so the modifier no longer sets the lock before the function body.
Delete `__lock_modifier0_lock = false;` so the lock is never released, making any second withdrawAll call revert.
